about: Throwback filter rules. Single source of truth: bundled into the APK at build time, and installed apps fetch the latest copy at most once a day.
schema: bump ONLY for breaking changes (older apps then ignore the file). version: must increase on every edit (yyyymmddNN); apps keep the copy with the highest version.
Path patterns are regular expressions matched against the URL path only (no query). Use the common subset of Java and JavaScript regex.

Selectors are matched against Instagram's mobile web DOM. Use stable signals only (href, aria-label, role, visible text), never Instagram's generated class names. Captions and video descriptions must never be hidden (DECISIONS.md #15).
Fields named 'note' and 'about' are documentation only; the app ignores them.

hosts.note: instagram: filtered and kept in Throwback. internal: Instagram/Meta account pages kept in Throwback without filters. login: Facebook/Meta login, kept in Throwback only while a login flow is in progress, otherwise opened in another app. linkShims: outbound link redirectors; the target in 'param' is opened directly in another app. blockedUrls: links that would open the Instagram app or an app store; they do nothing.

blocked.note: A single reel (shared in a DM, or from a link) opens as a plain post: one video, no endless Reels feed.
Newer share links of the form /<user>/reel/<code>/.
The Reels tab on a profile goes to the profile's posts instead.
The Reels tab and anything else under /reels/ or /reel/.
'Discover people' is a page of suggested accounts.

hide.note: Reels tab in the bottom bar, the Reels tab on profiles, and 'Original audio' links that open the Reels feed. Links to a single /reel/ are kept; tapping them opens the post.
Reels tab found by its icon label, in case its link changes.
'Get the app' / 'Open in app' links and store badges.
Fallback for the Explore grid: hides every tile. The script also hides the grid's container (see 'explore').
Messages-only mode: Home links and the inbox's back arrow.

hide.selector: svg[aria-label='Home'], svg[aria-label='Search'], svg[aria-label='Explore'], svg[aria-label='Search & Explore' i], svg[aria-label='New post'], svg[aria-label='Notifications']
hide.note: Messages-only mode: navigation buttons found by their icon labels.

hideText.note: 'Open in app' buttons in banners and headers.

posts.note: A feed post (container) is hidden when one of these labels is in its header: at most 'maxMediaBefore' images/videos (the avatar) come before the label, and the label sits in the top 'headerMaxFraction' of the post. A caption that happens to say the same words always comes after the photo or video, so it is never matched.

labels.note: Ads. Instagram labels them 'Sponsored' or, newer, 'Ad' (matched as the whole label, in the post header only). The translations are best effort.
Posts from accounts you don't follow.

modules.note: Feed blocks headed by these words (account carousels, suggested reels) are removed as a whole.

sectionMarkers.note: After 'You're all caught up', Instagram can continue with suggested posts under this heading. The heading and everything after it in the feed is removed.

dialogs.note: Cookie consent: picks the most private option automatically.

whenText: See this post in the app
Add Instagram to your Home screen
dialogs.note: 'Use the app' sheets and the web push prompt (a WebView can't receive web push anyway).

appSettings.note: With the Instagram app connected, a row at the end of Instagram's settings page opens the app's 'Settings and activity' (instagram://settings -> SettingsUrlHandlerActivity, checked on the emulator 2026-11-20). Its sub-pages mostly stay in that screen (no time limit); some (Meta Accounts Center) open in the app's main screen, which also holds the feed. Back out of settings also lands on that main screen (feed) and Android reports no 'closed' event to tell them apart, so otherScreenMinutes is 0 (owner, 2026-11-20): the main screen is never allowed; Accounts Center is on Instagram's website, in Throwback.

triggers.selector: a[href='#'] svg[aria-label='Home'], svg[aria-label='New post'], svg[aria-label='Create'], [aria-label='New post'], a[href^='/create/'], a[href='/create']

story.note: Instagram's story camera, gallery and editor live in its main screen (with the feed); the link lands on the feed (owner's phone), so the user swipes right for the camera. The pass gives editMinutes of Instagram, not counting time with the camera on (Android reports camera use to every app; seen on the owner's phone); Instagram's posting notification ends it; 3 a day (owner, 2026-11-20).

appCreate.note: The top bar's '+' (opens Post/Story) is an a[href='#'] whose icon Instagram labels 'Home' (2026-11-20); the story bubble's '+' badge is 'Plus icon'. With the Instagram app connected, '+' and 'Your story' open the app's create screen (better editor). The guard allows only its creation screens (activity class pattern); the feed after posting ends the pass. The link opened MediaCaptureActivity on the emulator (2026-11-20).

actions.note: aria-labels of Instagram's own Like/Unlike/Save/Remove buttons on a post page; the Explore reel player presses them (no requests of its own).

explore.note: The Explore grid shows for dailySeconds a day (time actually on the Explore tab), then it is hidden: the search box stays; every block that holds post tiles (and not the search box) is hidden, and Throwback shows 'Enough for today'.

nav.links: a[href='/'], a[href^='/explore'], a[href$='/reels/'], a[href^='/direct/inbox'], a[href='/accounts/activity/'], svg[aria-label='New post']
nav.note: The bottom bar is the smallest block that holds at least minLinks of these and no post content. It is hidden in messages-only mode, and slots whose only link is hidden collapse so the remaining icons spread out.

settingsSection.note: Throwback adds its own section (opens Throwback's settings) to Instagram's settings page, right after the section with one of these headings.

feedData.note: Removes ads and suggestions from Instagram's feed DATA before the page draws it (no flicker, exact end). Page filtering stays as the safety net. Checked on a real phone 2026-11-20: feed pages come from /graphql/query (PolarisFeedRootPaginationCachedQuery) as edges whose node has exactly one of media (followed), explore_story (suggested; post at explore_story.media) or ad. friendship_status.following is NOT reliable (false on some followed-feed posts), so it is not used.

reelViewer.note: A reel opened from a chat plays in Instagram's full-screen swipe viewer (same address, a vertical scroll-snap strip of videos). The opened reel is free; the poster shows on a random swipe between posterOnSwipeMin and posterOnSwipeMax (picked each time a new count starts; swipes count within windowMinutes), then the viewer stops. After the poster, no free swipes for cooldownMinutes (stored on the device, so restarting doesn't reset it).

stories.note: Seen on the owner's phone 2026-11-20: stories come from /graphql/query (PolarisStoriesV3ReelPageGallery[Pagination]Query, key xdt_api__v1__feed__reels_media__connection) in batches covering upcoming people; story ads come separately (PolarisStoriesV3AdsPoolQuery, key xdt_injected_story_units) and are emptied. Videos are fetched in pieces (bytestart/byteend). Look-ahead keeps the first prefetchKB of the next prefetchAhead videos in memory and hands them to the player.

notifications.note: Messages & calls relay (DECISIONS 26): how the Instagram app's notifications are sorted. Calls are always recognised by Android's own signals (category 'call', CallStyle, a full-screen intent) before these rules and are never touched. 'classify' is checked in order, first match wins; every field set must match (channel, template, group, tag: regex; category: exact; ongoing: true/false). Kinds: call, message, missedCall, likes, comments, follows, mentions, live, other. Without a match: category 'missed_call' = missedCall, category 'msg' or MessagingStyle = message, ongoing = call (an ongoing Instagram notification is most likely a call in progress), anything else = unknown, handled by 'unknown' (cancel or keep). threadId: where a message notification carries the chat id (from: shortcut, tag or group; pattern's first group, 5-40 digits), null = open the inbox. callGraceSeconds: the guard keeps allowing the Instagram app this long after the last call notification goes away. Channel ids read from the owner's phone on 2026-11-20 (Android's channel list for com.instagram.android, app metadata only): ig_direct, ig_direct_requests (messages); ig_direct_video_chat (calls); ig_likes, ig_comment_likes, ig_likes_and_comments_on_photos_of_you; ig_heads_up_comments; ig_new_followers, ig_connections, ig_private_user_follow_request; ig_mentions_in_bio, ig_photos_of_you; ig_live_videos; calls in progress may use channels created only during a call, so any channel naming call/rtc/video_chat is a call and the catch-all 'other' never takes an ongoing notification (ongoing = call by default); missed calls (category missed_call) are messages, not calls; ig_alerts (security and login alerts, e.g. 'Was this you?') are kept untouched; only ongoing notifications on call channels count as calls; uploads/ig_posting_status are other; everything else (ig_highlights, ig_first_posts_and_stories, ig_shopping_drops, ig_product_announcements, ig_view_counts, ig_alerts, ig_other, reminders, uploads, ...) = other.
